statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk stays low because the overnight advance was fully retraced, while stress remains high on the energy and inflation channels.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON, with a narrow flagged window from 13:30 to 15:00 UTC covering the post-holiday US cash reopen. Tail remains well below the block threshold; the elevated readings sit in stress rather than in a persistent no-retracement price path.
headline: Nasdaq-100 round-trips its overnight range as oil-led stress builds into the post-holiday US reopen
body: NQ futures trade near 29,585, up about 0.07% on the session, after a complete round trip: the overnight advance to 29,764.75 was fully retraced to a 29,478.00 low before price recovered to mid-range. That finished two-way path, with VIX near 15.6, is the central reason tail risk stays low, because mean reversion is visibly still functioning rather than failing. Stress is a different matter. WTI trades near $94 and Brent near $99, the highest since early summer, after verified Houthi strikes on Saudi energy facilities including the 400,000 barrel-per-day Jizan refinery, which wounded more than 70 people and halted operations at some sites. Offsetting that, Iran has said a Strait of Hormuz arrangement with Oman is days away, so the energy channel carries escalation and de-escalation headlines simultaneously. Cross-asset signals are conflicting rather than aligned: Nasdaq-100 futures sit near flat while Dow futures are down about 0.7% and Russell futures about 0.4%, and gold is easing near $4,442 rather than bidding. The rates channel remains live with the 2-year near 4.34% and the 10-year near 4.78% into a strong August payrolls report, and NFIB small business optimism printed 98.7 for August against a 99.3 consensus. US cash equities reopen at 13:30 UTC after the Labor Day holiday, which is the flagged window; the assessment treats that reopen as a checkpoint rather than as observed one-way structure.

lookbackSummary: Across the last 24 hours the assessment stayed in the EA_ON band with tail between 5 and 10 and no reading near the block threshold. Stress rose from the low 60s during Monday's Labor Day holiday session to 68 by 08:00 UTC as crude extended on the Saudi refinery strikes, and the dominant mode remained mixed throughout as cross-asset signals kept diverging from Nasdaq price action. The 09:00 UTC slot has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The near-term focus is the 13:30 UTC US cash reopen after the Labor Day holiday, where concentrated post-holiday order flow lifts conditional tail into the low teens before easing through the midday lull and the 15:00 UTC NY Fed inflation expectations print. Overnight, the Middle East energy channel remains the main source of a plausible step change in either direction, given simultaneous escalation and Hormuz de-escalation headlines. Beyond this horizon, PPI on 10 September, Oracle results the same evening, CPI on 11 September and the 15-16 September FOMC meeting form the event stack; conditional tail is raised only modestly at the end of the horizon to reflect that build-up rather than observed structure.
